senses.gloss: Relating to, founded on, or prescribed by, the Veda.
Audible, expressed in plain language (as a simile, opp. to आर्थ implied).
तम् Any observance prescribed by the Vedas.
Preservation or maintenance of the sacred fire.

The three sacred fires collectively, (i. e. गार्हपत्य, आहवनीय and दक्षिण).-Comp. -कर्मन् n. a Vedic rite. -मार्गः hearing.-सूत्रम् N. of a class of Sūtra works based on the Veda (ascribed to आश्वलायन, सांख्यायन, कात्यायन &c.).
Proficiency in the Vedas. -a. Relating to the ear; यश्चायमध्यात्मं श्रौत्रः प्रातिश्रुत्करतेजोमयो$मृतमयः पुरुषः Bṛi. Up.2.5.6.
श्रौषट् [śrauṣaṭ], ind. An exclamation or formula used in making an offering with fire to the gods or departed spirits; cf. वषट् or वौषट्.
Belonging to, or coming from, Srughna.
Residing in Srughna. -घ्नः An inhabitant of Srughna. -घ्नम् The gate leading to Srughna; cf. P.IV.3.86.
